title: CrowdStrike fiscal Q2 2027 Form 10-Q
excerpt: Fiscal Q2 revenue was USD 1.470897 billion, ending ARR was USD 5.841421 billion, quarterly net-new ARR was USD 332.8 million, six-month operating cash flow was USD 1.121205 billion, and diluted weighted-average shares were 1.044469 billion.
summary: The latest periodic filing confirms accelerating net-new ARR and improving GAAP results, while stock compensation, acquisition spending, dilution, incident liabilities and renewal-definition caveats remain material to per-share valuation.
